name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a single conditional ('If you pick up the key, you must also open the door'), and the hard RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) matches it exactly — the no-timing cue 'also' allows the door to be opened before or after the key is picked up. The key pickup is an 'if' condition, not a commanded goal, so no Existence clause is required, and the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES is valid for a task made only of a conditional rule.

texts: If the agent picks up the matching door key, then the door must also be opened at some point.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
